registryEntry.label: Restrict Nonessential Windows Services: Connected Devices, Internet Sharing (Intune)
registryEntry.set_command: $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations' -Body (@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.windows10GeneralConfiguration';displayName='CMMC-NonEssential-Services';description='CMMC CM.L2-3.4.7[o]: Connected Devices Service and Internet Connection Sharing off';connectedDevicesServiceBlocked=$true;internetSharingBlocked=$true} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
